content: Kughwegha kwa Babeli
Mbole ya agha, nikinmona nndumitumi yungi ywa kunani kwa Chapanga, pakahuluka kuhuma kunani. Kakibhegha na likalama likulu, na nnima ghukimulikwa kwa lung'ali lwake.
Naywo kakikweha lilobhe likulu, pakalongela, “Ghughwihwa. Ghughwihwa ghwenga Babeli nkulu. Hinu ghubhegha pahala pa kutama nchipila na mandilo, utamo ghwa kila kiyuni na anyama bhanakuyaghabhiha.

Mana bhandu bha milima yoha bhanywegha difwai ngalipo ya ungongola ghwake. Nabho abhatwa bha nnima bhatenda ungongola naywo, na ahemengania bha munnima bhamota utopelo kubhukana na utangalo ghwa utopelo ghwake ghwanga kihwani.”
Mbole, nikiyihwa lilobhe lingi kuhuma kunani, palilongela,

content.text: “Mmuke bhandu bhangu mukitami aki, mwenga bhandu bhangu.
ili nkotoke kumokola kihyato kyake kyohele.
Kiyaha ulemwa ghwake ghubhegha ntangalo muno, ghulundamana mbaka kunani,
na Chapanga kaghukulungwa kubhahyata bhandu abha.”
munmuyihile pabhili kubhukana na ghala ghakabhatendelite.
Munhanganile mu nnobho ghwake paubhili difwai ngalipakyanalumu
Munpeghe kimbamanda na ubhabho kulandana na kuliloka kwa ywombe
kulandaniha na kutama kwake kwa ungongola.
“Kubhukana na agha, yitantula mipinguhi kwa linjubha limu
kiyaha Bambo Chapanga ywakantosa, ndo Chapanga yunamakakala.”

content: Abhatwa bha mnnima bhaatyalite naywo na kutama naywo mumatamo ghaungongola, bhatannilila na kunkukulikila paapala kubhona lyohi lya kitami akyo paghukanjanganika.
Bhaayima kutali kwa bhwaghalili ghwa mabhino ghake. Paalongela, “Kighubhone. Kighubhone. Babeli kitami kihwadali na kina makakala. Kihyato kyako kighutula mulisaa limu.”
Ahemenganiha bha nnima bhaalila na kunkukulikila kwakya ywombe, kiyaha kahone mundu ywakahighahilite ywa kuhemela hilibhi hyabhe,

Kahone kangi mundu ywa kuhemela sahabu yabhe, mbiya, maganga ghana utopelo na madini ghaaghakemagha lulu, mapinda mahuhu mbulete na mapinda gha langi ya salabati, halili na mapinda makele, hyombo hya nhanganganiko ghwa mikongo ya kighweka. Hyombo hya mapalapi gha ndembo na hya mikongo ya utopelo nkulu na hya madini gha mahabha, kyuma na melemele,

nndalasini, ndimbililo, ubanu, mahuta gha kunungila, udi. Na difwai, mahuta, ukobha ghwa nyanyi na ngano. Anyama senga na mene, anyama bhaakemwa fwalasi na mutuka hya kukwakwahwa. Abhandwa na bhandu bhangi.

Ahemenganiha bhaalongela, “Hilibhi hyoha hya maha highuhipalite hibhuhwa, hya ghuhobheha hilibhi hyoha utopelo hiikutendite na kubhegha nhwadali hikupyatanguka, ghwahotola ng'obhe kuhimokola kangi ndwee!”
Ahemenganiha, bhala bhaamokolite utopelo kubhukana na kitami akyo, bhaayima kutali kubhukana na bhwaghalili ghwa kimbamanda kyake. Bhaalila na kukulika paayobha kyobho,
paalongela, “Milando mihakataho yighutula ghwenga kitami kikulu. Ghuuhwalihitwe mapinda gha mahuhu gha mbulete, gha langi ya salabati na ngele, paghulipamba kwa sahabu, maganga gha utopelo na lulu.
Kwa lisaa limu ghweka utopelo ghwako ghwoha ghulaghala.” Ahola bhwato bhoha na bhaabheghite mu mwanja ghwabhe, ahemenganiha na bhoha bhaatenda lihengo mu lihibha, bhaayima kutali na ywombe,
na paapala kubhona lyohi lya kuhyoka kitami kila, bhatalila na kulongela, “Bhuli, kukiyigha na kubwituka kitami kikulu handa aki!”

Bhandu abho bhakilidikulila lihu mu mitwe yabhe kunu paalila kwa lilobhe na kukukulika, paalongela, “Kighubhone. Kighubhone ghwenga kitami kikulu, ghu kitami kyene bhoha bhaabheghite na meli mu mahibha bhakimota utopelo kukindila utopelo ghwake. Mu lisaa limu ghweka ghwalaghala.”
Nnyelelwe mwenga munakutama kunani, nnyelelwe mwenga bhandu bha Chapanga na andumilwa na mambuye. Kiyaha Chapanga katatosa bhandu kwa milando yakaatendelite mwenga.

Mbole, nndumitumi yumu yuna makakala kakiyinula libho likulu handa libho lya kuhyaghila, kakilitagha mulihibha pakalongela, “Habhu ndo kitami kikulu kya Babeli pakipala kuponehwa pahi na kyanga kubhonekena kangi.

Miyimbo ya ahona migombo na bhanakuyimba, apyemba filimbi na malobhe gha apyemba mipalapi, ghaayihwanika ng'obhe kangi nkati ya kitami akyo. Kangi, nkati mwako kaabhonekana ng'obhe ntendehi ywohele, bhubho yaayihwanika ng'obhe kangi lilobhe lya libho lya kuhyaghila mukitami kyako.

Lung'ali lwa limbamba lwaang'aliha ndwee kangi nkati mwako, kwaayihwanika ndwee kangi malobhe gha bambo yunakutolela na nndala yunakutolelwa nkati mwako. Ahemenganiha bhako bhakibhegha bhandu ahwadali munnima, kiyaha bhandu bha milima yoha bhakipotohwa kwa uhabhi ghwako.”
Kitami akyo kikihyatulwa, kiyaha amwo bhandu bha Chapanga bhakikomwa, na kitami akyo yikibhonekana myahi ya mambuye na ya atumilwa na ya bhandu bhoha bhaakomitwe munnima.
